Keep fobs away from phones/wireless chargers that can desync them.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Confirm the VIN/build range and inspect whether the condition is the sticky surface described by SSP99 rather than cracking, warping, splitting, contamination, or another failure. Mazda's specified repair was complete dashboard replacement, historically using BBM4-60-400H-02, after dealer verification. SSP99 extended coverage to 10 years from the original warranty start date, so all eligible vehicles are now beyond that stated time window; ask the dealer to confirm current part supersession and any case-specific assistance before authorising a paid repair. A generic overlay, mat, vinyl wrap, or protectant is not Mazda's repair and should not be sold as the fix.
